headline: Health department closes Vietopia Bistro for imminent health hazard; reopened two days later
title: Health closure: Vietopia Bistro
why_it_matters: Salt Lake County Health Department closed Vietopia Bistro at 1407 W 9000 S on Sept. 28, 2026 for an imminent health hazard; the record does not state the reason. It reopened Sept. 30.

headline: Health department closes 21Lux apartments outdoor pool
title: Health closure: 21Lux Apts - Outdoor Pool
why_it_matters: 21Lux Apts outdoor pool at 204 W 2100 S closed Oct. 6; Sept. 29 inspection cited loose grab rails, missing skimmer weir, broken restroom sink, no soap or towels. Not reopened.

headline: Health department shuts Los Panchitos food truck over handwashing violations
title: Health closure: Los Panchitos #Us95Ag
why_it_matters: Los Panchitos food truck at 3232 S 400 E had its permit suspended Oct. 7 after 8 critical violations. The truck had no soap or hand-drying provision, and employees were preparing food without proper handwashing; it has not reopened.

headline: Artesian Springs Apartments pool in Murray closed by health department
title: Health closure: Artesian Springs Apts - North W/P #2
why_it_matters: The Artesian Springs Apartments north pool at 4197 S Main St, Murray, was closed Oct. 7 and has not reopened. The only inspection report provided is from June 23 and lists non-critical issues (missing skimmer weirs and check valves, no operation plan, no soap in a shower), so the closure reason is not stated.
